name: Groq Simple Chat with Knowledge Base

parameters.content:
## Setup
1. Get a free Groq API key: https://console.groq.com/keys
2. Open the **Call Groq** node and paste your key into the `Authorization` header value, replacing `YOUR_GROQ_API_KEY_HERE`.
3. Open the **Knowledge Base** node and replace the placeholder text with your own markdown (FAQ, policy doc, whatever you want the bot grounded on).
4. Click **Chat** at the bottom of the canvas to test.

No vector store, no embeddings — the whole knowledge base is just pasted into the prompt every time (see Module 9, approach (a), in the workshop doc).

# Example Knowledge Base

Replace this with your own markdown. Example content:

## Refund policy
Refunds are issued within 14 days of purchase if the product is unused. Contact billing@example.com with your order number.

## Support hours
Support is available Monday-Friday, 09:00-17:00 WIB. Outside these hours, tickets are queued and answered the next business day.
